text:
maya: Heads-up — customer reported two issues on their private deploy: audit logs not arriving to the collector and KMS key unwrap failures when restoring model checkpoints. Opening thread to triage and coordinate a fix. ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-4221

sam: Can you drop the error lines from the agent logs? Also, are they using Vault+HSM or some cloud KMS proxy? :question:

maya: Paste from agent: `2026-02-12T14:03:21Z agent[kms] error: key unwrap failed: CKR_FUNCTION_FAILED (mechanism CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP)`
They run HashiCorp Vault with PKCS#11 HSM plugin (customer-managed HSM).

eric: That error smells like a mechanism mismatch. Our PKCS11 wrapper defaults to `CKM_RSA_PKCS` for unwrap on older HSMs; some HSMs require OAEP. We added a compatibility flag in hosted builds (2024-11) but never flowed it to Private agent config.

anna: On the audit side: ops noticed `auditd` was running but systemd `auditd.service` got masked during our hardening script when netpol was applied (we quietly set `ProtectSystem=strict` in the existing unit). So journals never forwarded. For air-gapped installs they expect `imfile` -> rsyslog -> syslog-over-TLS to collector.

security-oncall: This is severity-high for private customers. Two attack surfaces: (1) lost audit trail during an incident; (2) inability to unwrap keys to recover checkpoints. Need mitigation and a playbook update.

maya: Proposal: immediate customer patch to enable OAEP unwrap in agent, and a safe runbook to re-enable audit forwarding. Also add a deterministic test to our private deploy installer so netpol won't mask `auditd`.

sam: I can own the test harness and installer change. Quick config snippet I recommend adding to agent config for the customer (works for Vault+HSM):

```
# /etc/redwood/agent-kms.conf
pkcs11:
  enable: true
  mechanism_unwrap: CKM_RSA_PKCS_OAEP
  pkcs11_lib: /usr/lib/yourhsm/libpkcs11.so
  slot: 1
  token_label: "Vault-HSM"
```

eric: For Private agent binary — short-term we can document a CLI override: `redwood-agent --pkcs11-oaep=true` and ship a patch in the next minor. Long-term we should auto-detect mechanism via `C_GetMechanismList` and fallback. I'll open PR.

anna: Audit fix (temporary): enable persistent systemd journal + rsyslog imjournal + TLS forwarding. Example rsyslog config snippet I pushed to INC-4221:```
# /etc/rsyslog.d/50-redwood.conf
module(load="imjournal")
action(type="omfwd" Target="collector.redwood.local" Port="6514" Protocol="tcp" StreamDriver="gtls" StreamDriverMode="1" StreamDriverAuthMode="x509/name")
```

security-oncall: Also add an alert rule: if `auditd` status != active or `auditctl -s` shows rate limit, page oncall. Add a daily check to the private health probe.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: redwood/agent-patch@staging -> canary host group -> 15min -> rollback on >2% errors

maya: OK owners: sam -> installer/e2e, eric -> PKCS11 shim PR, anna -> audit forwarding + runbook updates, security-oncall -> alert rule + playbook edit. Sam/eric, coordinate with me for customer hotfix tonight.

sam: I'll open the RFC and start the harness. planning: test matrix includes HSMs that return OAEP vs PKCS#1 v1.5.

eric: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/agent/pulls/3389 (draft) — includes `--pkcs11-oaep` flag, auto-detect placeholder, unit tests. I'll mark for emergency review.

anna: I'll add auditd unit sanity test to the installer and a mitigation checklist in the runbook: "If auditd masked, run `systemctl unmask auditd && systemctl enable --now auditd` then validate rsyslog TLS stream."

maya: Good. Postmortem action items to track: 1) Ship agent patch, 2) Update installer tests, 3) Harden runbook and alerts, 4) Add PKCS11 OAEP CI test, 5) Customer follow-up and restore verification.

security-oncall: Also add a small incident playbook section for partial key unwrapping: steps to export wrapped key, run a supervised unwrap job with HSM vendor, and validate checksums of restored model shards.

maya: Thanks all — I'll coordinate the customer comms and create the follow-up ticket for SOC to validate logs after fix. :thumbsup:
